emails.subject: Interest in your GNN message passing work
emails.body:
Dear Professor Das,

I am a third-year CS undergraduate who built a GNN-based molecule property predictor using PyTorch Geometric, achieving 0.91 ROC-AUC on the Tox21 dataset.

I recently read your paper "Asynchronous Message Passing for Addressing Oversquashing in Graph Neural Networks" and found your approach to mitigating oversquashing insightful. My project involved message passing on molecular graphs, where long-range interactions are also critical, though I did not specifically address oversquashing.

I am seeking a 2-month summer research internship in your group to gain experience working on graph neural networks and message passing algorithms. Would you be open to discussing potential opportunities for this internship?

Thank you for considering my request.

Best regards,
Test Student
